title: Mailbox alias refusal guidance suggests unusable forms for ambiguous and multi-segment names
outcome: Refusal guidance directs ambiguous bare names and multi-segment host-label references to exact host UUID/native or canonical participant targets without changing recipients.
acceptance: Ambiguous bare names without :: receive a parseable host-UUID or exact-id suggestion, rather than another ambiguous literal or host:name without a separator.
A reference fenced by a host label containing :: never suggests a form that parses as another host; focused controls cover both shapes.
